notes:
An interface release. 0.5.7 hardened how K8Secret talks to your cluster; this one fixes how it behaves while you use it.

Live updates no longer fight you: pod logs stay put instead of clearing themselves mid-read, and a status change no longer reads as you clicking a different row. Replica counts can be typed instead of clicked one at a time, with a Stop button for scaling to zero, and the steppers now count from the number on screen rather than the cluster's last report. A confirmation dialog can no longer be replaced before you answer it, so nothing acts on a request you never read.

Text renders in full: namespace names, cluster IPs and ports no longer truncate or wrap character by character, and ports are identifiers again rather than quantities with thousands separators. First launch gives you a readable sidebar and a content column that fits its own text.

Spurious keychain password prompts are gone. Keychains left behind by a crash or force-quit are now cleaned up properly, and a second window can no longer pull the keychain out from under a running one. Saves show a spinner while they reach your cluster, and animations honour Reduce Motion.
